name: Sekhmet
source:
A biological logic engine created by Neferuaten of Amat. She is part of a two-part system with Eshmun, and analyzes models of potential human dysfunction to ascertain their accuracy and determine the appropriate time and manner of intervention.

[Edited from [url=https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/28806/the-flower-that-bloomed-nowhere/chapter/590572/028-in-fading-image]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Chapter 28[/url]]
